licence.name: driver licence, class B (any motor car)

note: Read 2026-11-03 on the Government's law site (cookislandslaws.gov.ck, the Crown Law Office). The Transport (Motor Driver Licensing) Regulations 2016: someone who hasn't held a licence in the last five years may apply for a learner licence only (reg. 6(1)) and must hold it at least two years before a full licence of any class (reg. 6(2)); a learner licence of 'class A1 or class B if he or she is 16 or 17 years of age or over' (reg. 6(3)(a)). That phrase is read as A1 from sixteen and B from seventeen, as reg. 4(2) sets A1 at sixteen on its own; so a full class B licence is held from 19 (17 plus the two years; a reading). Reg. 9 (as replaced by SN 2021/13): a licence for 1, 5 or 10 years, but no ten-year licence from 65 and no five- or ten-year one from 70 (held as the terms' ages), one year from 75; from 65 or 70 a licence may instead run to the day before 75, not held. Reg. 24: NZ$20 for one year, NZ$60 for five, NZ$100 for ten (the learner licence NZ$30 isn't held). The Transport Act 1966 s. 20 sets ages only for heavy and passenger vehicles. No identity card and no exchange list were read.

sources.title: Transport (Motor Driver Licensing) Regulations 2016, reg. 24 Licence fees, Cook Islands Laws
sources.said: (1) The fees for driver licences are— (a) $30 for a learner licence: (b) $20 for a visitor licence: (c) $20 for a 1-year licence: (d) $60 for a 5-year licence: (e) $100 for a 10-year licence.
